keep_features.feature_value: Single mother denied help due to moral condemnation; portrays being punished while church takes offerings
keep_features.evidence_span: "I had sinned by having a baby outside of marriage, therefore I didn't deserve help" / "They sure as hell took my money offerings though."
keep_features.rationale: The post emphasizes being refused assistance and unjustly judged, framing the speaker as a victim of harsh moral policing.

keep_features.feature_value: Implicit directive against not voting; urges political participation
keep_features.evidence_span: "Except the presidential election isn't a restaurant you can leave." / "One of those choices **will** be chosen." / "Throwing a tantrum and staying home just lets... decide your future."
keep_features.rationale: The language discourages staying home and steers readers toward participating in the election.

keep_features.evidence_span: "If you're new to following me there are some things you should know."
